```{python}
from ucimlrepo import fetch_ucirepo 
import pandas as pd
  

breast_cancer_wisconsin_diagnostic = fetch_ucirepo(id=17) 
  
X = breast_cancer_wisconsin_diagnostic.data.features 
y = breast_cancer_wisconsin_diagnostic.data.targets 
```

```{python}
#| output: false
y = y.rename(columns={y.columns[0]: "target"})


y["target"] = y["target"].map({"M": 1, "B": 0})
```

```{python}
#| output: false
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
y = y["target"].values.ravel()

X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(
    X, y,
    test_size=0.25,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=y
)
```

```{python}
#| output: false
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression

log_reg = LogisticRegression(max_iter=5000)
log_reg.fit(X_train, y_train)
```

```{python}
y_pred = log_reg.predict(X_test)
y_prob = log_reg.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]
```

```{python}
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score, precision_score, recall_score, roc_auc_score

print("Accuracy:", accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred))
print("Precision:", precision_score(y_test, y_pred))
print("Recall:", recall_score(y_test, y_pred))
print("ROC AUC:", roc_auc_score(y_test, y_prob))
```

```{python}
pd.set_option('display.max_rows', None)
```

```{python}
coef = pd.DataFrame({
    "feature": X.columns,
    "coef": log_reg.coef_[0]
}).sort_values(by="coef", ascending=False)

print(coef)
```

```{python}
top3_features = [
    #considerando o modulo mesmo
    "concavity3",
    "radius1",
    "texture2"
]
X_reduced = X[top3_features]
```

```{python}
#| output: false
X_train_r, X_test_r, y_train_r, y_test_r = train_test_split(
    X_reduced, y,
    test_size=0.25,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=y
)
```

```{python}
#| output: false
log_small = LogisticRegression(max_iter=5000)
log_small.fit(X_train_r, y_train_r)
```

```{python}
y_pred_r = log_small.predict(X_test_r)
y_prob_r = log_small.predict_proba(X_test_r)[:, 1]
```

```{python}
print(f"Completo ({X_test.shape[1]} variáveis)")
print("Accuracy:", accuracy_score(y_test, y_pred))
print("Precision:", precision_score(y_test, y_pred))
print("Recall:", recall_score(y_test, y_pred))
print("ROC AUC:", roc_auc_score(y_test, y_prob))
print("\n", "=" * 20, "\n")
print(f"REDUZIDO ({X_test_r.shape[1]} variáveis)")
print("Accuracy:", accuracy_score(y_test_r, y_pred_r))
print("Precision:", precision_score(y_test_r, y_pred_r))
print("Recall:", recall_score(y_test_r, y_pred_r))
print("ROC AUC:", roc_auc_score(y_test_r, y_prob_r))
```
